title: ap-audit: AP re-scoring tools for oriented ship detection under missing modalities
description:
Pure-Python tools that recompute average precision from exported prediction files under either the all-point or the 11-point interpolation rule, switch the recall denominator between the full ground-truth set and the subset that remains after doubly-missing samples are excluded, and score the same predictions against either optical or SAR annotations.

Every number reported in the accompanying letter can be re-derived offline from a single prediction file; no training is required to reproduce a metric. The tools depend only on the Python standard library.
